wf.title: Canva Posts & Posters Designer
wf.brief: Seeking an experienced Canva designer skilled in creating high-quality, professional Instagram posts and promotional posters. Designs should feature: - Clean and balanced layouts - Eye-catching typography - A cohesive brand identity Most tasks will focus on these formats: 1. Instagram Posts: Square 1080×1080 2. Posters: Versatile for both digital use and print Deliverables include: - Editable Canva links - High-resolution PNG/JPG files - Print-ready PDFs (for posters) Delivery timeline will be flexible depending on the project scope. This is an ongoing collaboration with opportunities for fresh creative ideas while staying true to brand guidelines.
wf.summary: Client needs Canva designs for Instagram posts (1080x1080), posters, and stories, matching brand guidelines and provided copy.

practice.q: What does the client REALLY need from each design beyond looking nice?
options: Fancy artwork that impresses other designers
Consistent on-brand visuals that carry the event or offer clearly
The most colourful design possible every time
practice.why: Clients post these to announce events and offers, so each design must match the brand and make the message instantly clear. Pretty alone won't sell the offer.
practice.need: I'll turn your event and offer briefs into on-brand Canva posts and posters, ready for Instagram and print.

wf.skill: Briefing the client and matching brand guidelines
wf.pitch: I'd love to design your Instagram posts and posters in Canva, keeping everything true to your brand colours and logo. For each brief I'll send an editable link plus high-res PNG/JPG files, and a print-ready PDF for posters. Would you like to share a sample brief to start?

wf.title: Modern Cafe Wall Menu Design
wf.brief: I'm looking for a skilled designer to create a modern and clean wall menu board for my cafe. Requirements: - Wall menu board design - Include food and drink names with prices - Modern and clean aesthetic Ideal Skills and Experience: - Graphic design proficiency - Experience with menu board layouts - Ability to create a modern and clean design Please provide samples of previous work.
wf.summary: Client wants a modern, clean wall menu board for their cafe with food and drink names and prices.

practice.q: What does the client REALLY need from this wall menu board?
options: Fancy artwork with lots of decoration
Quick-to-read prices and items, clean layout
A full brand identity and logo redesign
practice.why: Wall menus get read from a distance in seconds. Clear hierarchy, readable prices, and uncluttered spacing matter more than decoration. Keep the clean look the client asked for.
practice.need: I'll design a clean, easy-to-scan wall menu with clear prices and sections for food and drinks.

wf.skill: Making the offer impossible to miss
wf.pitch: Hi, I'd love to design your cafe's wall menu board. I'll create a clean, modern layout where food and drink names and prices are easy to read from across the room. Would you like to see a sample layout before we start?

wf.title: Logo Refinement and Marketing Material Design
wf.brief: I'm looking for a designer to refine my existing real estate logo and create cohesive business cards and marketing materials. Requirements: - Logo: Tweak text, spelling, or font for clarity while maintaining the current look. - Business Cards: Design to match the updated logo. - Marketing Materials: Flyers, brochures, etc., keeping a consistent brand image. Ideal Skills: - Graphic Design expertise - Experience in real estate branding - Attention to detail - Strong typography skills Please provide samples of previous work.
wf.summary: Client wants a real estate logo with clearer text/spelling, plus matching business cards and flyers/brochures.

practice.q: What does the client REALLY need most: a brand new logo, or a cleaned-up version of the existing logo that keeps its look?
options: A brand new logo from scratch
A clearer version that keeps the current look
Only the business cards, no logo changes
practice.why: They asked to tweak text, spelling, or font while keeping the current look. Preserve the brand's recognition and fix clarity. Don't redesign it from zero. Matching the cards and flyers to that updated logo comes next.
practice.need: I'll refine your logo's text and typography while keeping its look, then match your cards and flyers to it.

wf.skill: Briefing the client: confirming what must stay the same
wf.pitch: I'd love to help refine your real estate logo so the text is clearer while keeping the look you already have. I'll also design matching business cards and a flyer so your brand looks consistent everywhere. Would you like to share the current logo file so I can start?

wf.title: Promotional Social Media Post Graphics
wf.brief: I need a creative designer to craft eye-catching post graphics for my feed that focus on promoting my products and services. The visuals must feel cohesive across Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn while still respecting the nuances of each platform. Expect to work with existing brand colours, fonts, and a style guide I will share, then translate that into scroll-stopping imagery paired with concise, high-impact copy placeholders. Deliverables: • At least six static feed posts, supplied in native design files (PSD or AI) plus ready-to-upload PNG/JPEG exports in platform-specific sizes. • Editable text layers so I can update offers and captions. • A quick usage note showing layout grids, font
wf.summary: Client wants six cohesive social post graphics (Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn) using their brand style guide, with editable text layers.

practice.q: What does the client REALLY need beyond just pretty posts?
options: Six random eye-catching designs in any style
Consistent branded visuals that promote offers across platforms
A full social media strategy and posting calendar
practice.why: Cohesion and brand consistency matter more than novelty here. Read the style guide closely, then adapt each post to each platform's sizes and feel, with editable text so offers can change easily.
practice.need: I'll deliver six platform-sized, on-brand post graphics with editable text layers for your offers.

wf.skill: Turning a client's brand brief into consistent visuals
wf.pitch: Hi, I can create six on-brand post graphics for Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn using your colours and fonts, with editable text layers so you can update offers easily. I'll send native PSD or AI files plus ready-to-upload exports and a short layout guide.

wf.title: Modern Company Brochure Design
wf.brief: I'm looking for a modern and professional brochure to introduce my company and its services. The brochure will be shared with potential clients at meetings or events. The brochure should include: - Company story - Past jobs - Services - Contact details Ideal skills and experience: - Strong graphic design skills - Experience with brochure layouts - Ability to convey information clearly and attractively - Portfolio showcasing modern and professional designs Please provide samples of similar work.
wf.summary: Client wants a modern, professional company brochure with company story, past jobs, services and contact details, shared at meetings and events.

practice.q: What does the client really need the brochure to do once it's in a prospect's hands?
options: Look pretty on a shelf
Win trust and start conversations
Show every past project in detail
practice.why: Good call. A brochure handed out at meetings has one job: make a stranger trust you enough to call. Lead with clarity and credibility, not decoration. Keep text short and scannable.
practice.need: I'll design a clean, modern brochure that tells your company story and services clearly, ready for print.

wf.skill: Briefing the client: finding the real goal behind the request
wf.pitch: Hi, I read your brief for a modern company brochure. I'll design a clean, professional layout covering your story, past jobs, services and contact details, with print-ready files. Would you like to see a sample layout first?

wf.title: Event Graphics Design Specialist
wf.brief: I am looking for a graphic designer to design a poster for an upcoming performance. Our director did a mockup using ChatGPT, but I would like to hire a human to make the artwork. Must NOT use AI to generate your design. Looking to have the attached image recreated in your own style. Please provide a portfolio showcasing similar work.
wf.summary: Client wants a human-designed event poster, recreating an attached mockup in the designer's own style, no AI-generated art.

practice.q: The client says 'recreate the attached image in your own style.' What is the client really asking for?
options: Copy the mockup pixel for pixel
Rebuild the same layout with your own design choices
Generate a new poster with an AI tool
practice.why: They want the mockup's layout and message kept, but the artwork drawn and styled by you. Copying exactly or using AI both miss the point.
practice.need: I'll rebuild your poster by hand in my own style, keeping your mockup's layout and key info.

wf.skill: Briefing the client: clarifying what 'recreate' means
wf.pitch: Hi, I can design your performance poster by hand, keeping the layout and key details from your mockup while giving it my own clean style. I'll send you a first draft within two days for feedback. Would you like to share the event date, venue, and any brand colours?

cv.title: Tech Resume and CV Enhancement
cv.brief: My current resume and separate CV need a full professional refresh so they stand out for technology / engineering positions. The content is all there, but it requires sharper wording, stronger achievement-focused bullet points, and an intuitive structure that reads well for both hiring managers and applicant-tracking systems. Here’s what I need: • A rewritten resume (two pages max) and an expanded CV, each tailored specifically to technology or engineering roles. • Consistent formatting, modern layout, and crystal-clear section hierarchy. • Tight, active language that highlights technical skills, quantifies results, and incorporates industry-specific keywords naturally. • Clean, error-free c
cv.summary: Client wants a full refresh of a resume (2 pages) and expanded CV for tech/engineering roles, ATS-friendly.

practice.q: What does the client most need from this job?
options: Sharper, achievement-focused bullets with ATS keywords
Writing a cover letter from scratch
Finding them job openings to apply for
practice.why: This is a CV makeover: the content already exists, so the value is in tighter wording, quantified results, clean structure, and keywords that pass applicant-tracking systems. Read the brief closely.
practice.need: I'll rewrite your resume and CV for tech roles with quantified bullets and ATS keywords.

cv.skill: Turning existing experience into achievement bullets
cv.pitch: Hi, I read your brief for a tech and engineering CV refresh. I'll rewrite your two-page resume and expanded CV with sharp, achievement-focused bullets, clean formatting, and keywords that pass applicant-tracking systems. Could you share your current documents and a target role so I can start?

cv.title: Administrative Supervisor CV & Cover Letter
cv.brief: I’m looking for a skilled résumé writer who can create a compelling CV and cover letter that will position me for an Administrative Officer Supervisor post. This will be my first step into a formal supervisory role, so the documents have to emphasise transferable strengths, leadership potential, and any administrative tasks I have already handled, while also showing how those skills translate to managing an office team. Because I’m eyeing openings across corporate environments—particularly banks and IT-heavy organisations—please weave in language and keywords that speak to compliance, customer service, data accuracy, and basic tech literacy so the file is ready for standard ATS scans. Delive
cv.summary: Client wants a CV and cover letter for a first supervisory role as Administrative Officer Supervisor, ATS-ready for banks and IT firms.

practice.q: Which detail matters most for this client's ATS-scanned CV in banking and IT?
options: Bold colours and a photo
Keywords on compliance, accuracy and customer service
A long list of hobbies
practice.why: Good call. ATS filters scan for role keywords, so compliance, customer service, data accuracy and tech literacy must appear naturally in the text. Show transferable admin wins, not just duties.
practice.need: I'll write an ATS-ready CV and cover letter that positions you for your first supervisory role.

cv.skill: Interviewing your client to surface transferable wins
cv.pitch: Hi, I read your brief for an Administrative Officer Supervisor CV and cover letter, and I can help you make the leap into your first supervisory role.

cv.title: Online Job Application Assistant Needed -- 2
cv.brief: looking for somone to help me appply for jobs on line must be english literate apply for jobs and also search for jobs for me.
cv.summary: Client wants someone to apply for jobs online for them and also search for jobs on their behalf.

practice.q: Which part of this brief is the real job the client needs done?
options: Write a new CV from scratch
Apply to jobs and find listings for them
Interview them for a career plan
practice.why: The client wants two linked tasks: finding suitable listings and submitting applications. Read the whole brief and name both before pitching. A clear pitch shows you can handle both.
practice.need: I'll search job boards for you and submit tailored applications.

cv.skill: Reading the full brief before you bid
cv.pitch: Hi, I can help with this. I'll search job boards for roles that fit your background and submit tailored applications for each one. I'll send you a short list every week so you can see what went out. Which kinds of roles and locations should I focus on?

cv.title: Online Job Application Assistant Needed
cv.brief: looking for somone to help me appply for jobs on line must be english literate apply for jobs and also search for jobs for me.
cv.summary: Client wants someone to apply for jobs online for them and also search for jobs on their behalf.

practice.q: What does this client really need: someone to find and apply for jobs on their behalf, or someone to teach them to do it?
options: Find and apply for jobs for them
Teach them how to search and apply
Write a company's job advert
practice.why: Read the brief closely: they want a person who searches and applies on their behalf. Teaching or advertising jobs would miss the point. Confirm the scope before you bid.
practice.need: I'll search for relevant jobs and submit tailored online applications for you.

cv.skill: Interviewing your client to confirm the real scope
cv.pitch: Hi, I can help with this. I'll search for jobs that match your skills each week and send tailored online applications on your behalf, keeping you updated on every one. Which types of roles and locations are you aiming for?

ig.title: Facebook Reels Scheduling Assistant
ig.brief: ### Facebook Reels Scheduling Assistant – 30 Days I'm looking for a reliable freelancer to manage the scheduling and basic preparation of Facebook Reels for my Facebook Page for 30 days. This is a simple, ongoing task. I will provide the video content, and your responsibility will be to prepare and schedule it correctly. **Daily responsibilities:** - Schedule 5 Facebook Reels per day. - Use the videos provided by me. - Make simple edits when required, such as trimming, basic captions, or minor adjustments. - Keep the original video quality. - Follow the exact posting schedule below. - Check that all Reels are scheduled correctly. - Avoid uploading or publishing multiple Reels together. **Dai
ig.summary: Client wants 30 days of scheduling 5 Facebook Reels daily from their own videos, with light trims/captions, original quality kept, and no multiple Reels posted together.

practice.q: What does the client REALLY need from you here, beyond just uploading videos?
options: Creating new Reels ideas and scripts daily
Reliable, exact scheduling of 5 Reels a day, quality kept
Running paid ads to grow the Page fast
practice.why: The job is careful execution: the exact posting schedule, original quality, and spacing Reels out. Ideas, scripts, and ads aren't part of it, so don't pitch those.
practice.need: I'll schedule your 5 daily Reels exactly on your posting plan, keeping quality intact.

ig.skill: Following a precise plan without skipping steps
ig.pitch: Hi, I read your brief for 30 days of Reels scheduling. I'll schedule your 5 daily Reels exactly on your posting plan, keep the original quality intact, and make sure none go out together. Would you like a sample schedule from me first?

ig.title: Graphic designer for designing digital planners for my Etsy store
ig.brief: I need a graphic designer for my Etsy store who can create digital planners along with mockup images and a preview video. You should have experience using Canva or any other editing tool. The listed budget is for one digital planner, along with a cover image, 10 mockup images, and a short preview video. I'll provide the examples and details of the digital planner later. Contact me for more details.
ig.summary: Client needs a designer for digital planners on Etsy: a cover, 10 mockups, and a short preview video, using Canva or similar.

practice.q: What does the client actually need delivered for this one-planner job?
options: Just one planner file for download
A planner, cover, 10 mockups, and preview video
Ongoing monthly Etsy listing management
practice.why: Read the brief closely: one planner, one cover image, ten mockups, and a short preview video. Scope is defined by the listed deliverables, so count them before you quote.
practice.need: I'll design your digital planner, cover, 10 mockups, and a short preview video in Canva.

ig.skill: Scoping deliverables from the brief before you bid
ig.pitch: Hi, I can design your digital planner in Canva, along with a matching cover image, 10 mockup images, and a short preview video for your Etsy listing. I'll keep the style consistent with your examples once you share them. Would you like to send the planner details when you're ready?

ig.title: Create Social Media Canva Templates for Pediatric Occupational Therapy
ig.brief: Looking to design 15–20 editable Canva templates for Instagram and Facebook. The templates will include 2–3 layout/color variations per post, covering sensory tips, fine motor activities, developmental milestones, and clinic promotion posts. The goal is to create clean, engaging, and informative designs that help parents and clinics share valuable content while attracting engagement. Use soft pastel colors like sage green, warm cream, soft coral, and gentle mustard yellow with rounded shapes and playful yet clear typography. Include a bold headline area for 'Sensory Tip' or 'Fine Motor Activity', a clean bulleted or short text section for practical home activities, space for a friendly illus
ig.summary: Client wants 15-20 editable Canva templates for pediatric OT Instagram/Facebook posts, pastel colors, 2-3 variations each.

practice.q: What does the client REALLY need from this job?
options: Just pretty pastel graphics to post
Editable, on-brand templates clinics and parents can reuse
One-off custom designs for each post
practice.why: The brief asks for reusable, editable templates with variations, so the value is a flexible system clinics can reuse, not one-off art. Pretty alone misses the point. Check the editable requirement first.
practice.need: I'll build 15-20 editable Canva templates in your pastel palette, each with color variations.

ig.skill: Designing reusable templates that solve a real client need
ig.pitch: I'd love to create your 15-20 editable Canva templates for pediatric OT posts, in your soft sage, cream, coral and mustard palette. Each design will come with 2-3 layout variations so clinics and parents can reuse them easily. Would you like to see a sample template first?

ig.title: Google & Instagram Profile Makeover
ig.brief: We have recently renovated our restaurant and would like to update our online presence to reflect its new appearance and atmosphere. 1. Google Business Profile Remove all old photos uploaded by the business. Replace them with our new professional photos. Food and beverage photos uploaded by customers can remain. All new photos will be provided by us. 2. Instagram Account Remove all existing photos and posts. Upload the new photos provided by us. Create a fresh, modern and consistent appearance that reflects the newly renovated restaurant. Project Objective The goal is to refresh both platforms and ensure that our online presence accurately represents the restaurant's new design, atmosphere a
ig.summary: Client wants Google Business and Instagram cleared of old photos and refreshed with new restaurant renovation photos.

practice.q: What does the client REALLY need from this job?
options: Write new captions for every old post
Replace old business photos with theirs, keep customer photos
Create new menus and run paid ads
practice.why: Read the brief closely: remove old business photos, keep customer food photos, and upload the client's new photos to both platforms. Sticking to exactly that scope is the job.
practice.need: I'll replace your old photos on Google and Instagram with your new renovation shots, keeping a consistent look.

ig.pitch: Hi, I'd love to refresh your Google and Instagram for the renovation. I'll remove the outdated business photos, keep your customers' food shots, and upload your new photos into a clean, consistent look. Would you like me to start with Google or Instagram first?

ig.title: Social Media Tutorials for a Small Business
ig.brief: My budget is under $50, and I’m just looking for a short-term learning opportunity rather than ongoing management or extensive projects.
ig.summary: Client wants short Instagram tutorials teaching their small business to post on their own, for under $50.

practice.q: What does this client REALLY need from you?
options: Full account management and daily posting
Short hands-on lessons they can apply themselves
Paid ads setup and campaign strategy
practice.why: The brief says short-term learning, not ongoing management. Teach the owner to post well themselves, and keep the scope tight to fit the budget.
practice.need: I'll walk your team through a short, practical Instagram posting lesson within your $50 budget.

ig.skill: Teaching a small business to post on its own
ig.pitch: Hi, I read that you want short Instagram lessons so your team can post confidently on their own. I can deliver a focused, hands-on tutorial covering post planning, captions, and a simple weekly posting routine within your $50 budget. Would a short session like that work for you?

ig.title: Daily FB-IG Posts & TikTok
ig.brief: I’m ready to hand over my day-to-day social media scheduling so our feed stays active without me hovering over it. Here’s the rhythm I need you to keep: • Facebook and Instagram must feature a fresh post every single day, then cycle that same post automatically at 8 am, noon, and 5 pm. You’re free to use Meta Business Suite, Buffer, Later, Hootsuite—whatever calendar tool you trust—as long as it fires on time. • Each post should push our products and services up-front and motivate viewers to drop by the store. Clear calls to “come see us today” must sit alongside our street address, opening hours, simple map directions with parking notes, plus any in-store specials or events we’re running. C
ig.summary: Client wants daily FB/IG posts auto-scheduled at 8am, noon, 5pm, pushing products with store address, hours, directions, and specials.

practice.q: What must every post include beyond the product, so viewers actually visit the store?
options: Only a nice photo and hashtags
A clear 'come see us today' call with address and hours
Long captions about the brand's history
practice.why: Good work here means each post sells the visit. Pretty images alone won't bring people in. Put the call to visit, the address, hours, and directions right alongside the offer, then schedule it.
practice.need: I'll schedule daily FB and IG posts that drive store visits, with address, hours, and specials.

ig.skill: Making the offer impossible to miss
ig.pitch: I can set up your daily Facebook and Instagram posts at 8am, noon, and 5pm, each with a clear 'come see us today' call, your address, hours, and specials. Would you like me to start with this week's offers?
